description: TAS submission and approval workflow: TAS number generation with race condition handling using SELECT FOR UPDATE and IntegrityError retry (FINDING #4), employee TAS submission form with validation, employee dashboard and TAS history, admin TAS list/detail views, approve/reject actions with manual CSRF validation (FINDING #2), transaction boundary ensuring sequence and record commit together
steps: In app/utils.py, implement generate_tas_number(emp_id) function (FINDING #4): define max_retries=3; create for loop for attempt in range(max_retries); in loop try: query TASSequence.filter_by(emp_id=emp_id).with_for_update().first(); if seq_record is None create TASSequence(emp_id=emp_id, last_sequence=1), db.session.add(seq_record), db.session.flush() to detect IntegrityError immediately; else seq_record.last_sequence += 1; format tas_number = f'TAS-{emp_id}-{seq_record.last_sequence:04d}'; return tas_number; except IntegrityError: db.session.rollback(), if attempt == max_retries - 1 raise else continue (retry); after loop raise RuntimeError('Failed to generate TAS number after retries')

Add docstring to generate_tas_number: 'Generate unique TAS number for given employee ID in format TAS-{EMPID}-{SEQUENCE} (e.g. TAS-1987-0001). Uses row-level locking to prevent race conditions. IMPORTANT: Must be called within active transaction. Does NOT commit internally - caller must commit. IntegrityError during first-time sequence creation is retried up to 3 times with db.session.rollback() between retries. After 3 failures raises RuntimeError.'

In app/forms.py, create TASForm with travel_from StringField (DataRequired, Length(max=255)), travel_to StringField (DataRequired, Length(max=255)), travel_date_start DateField (DataRequired), travel_date_end DateField (DataRequired), purpose TextAreaField (DataRequired, Length(max=1000)), estimated_cost DecimalField (DataRequired, NumberRange(min=0)), submit; add validate_travel_date_start method: if field.data < date.today() raise ValidationError('Travel start date cannot be in the past'); add validate_travel_date_end method: if hasattr(self.travel_date_start, 'data') and self.travel_date_start.data and field.data < self.travel_date_start.data raise ValidationError('Travel end date must be after start date')
In app/routes/employee.py, create employee_bp blueprint
Implement GET /employee/submit_tas with @employee_required: render employee/submit_tas.html with TASForm

Implement POST /employee/submit_tas with @employee_required: validate form.validate_on_submit(); get emp_id = current_user.emp_id; if not emp_id flash error 'Your account is not linked to an employee record. Contact admin.' and redirect to employee.dashboard; in try block: call tas_number = generate_tas_number(emp_id) (does not commit), create TASRecord with tas_number, emp_id, form data (travel_from, travel_to, travel_date_start, travel_date_end, purpose, estimated_cost), status='Pending'; db.session.add(tas_record); db.session.commit() to commit both sequence update and TAS record together atomically; flash success f'TAS submitted successfully. Your TAS number is {tas_number}'; redirect to employee.tas_history; except Exception as e: db.session.rollback(), current_app.logger.error(f'Error submitting TAS: {str(e)}', exc_info=True), flash 'Failed to submit TAS. Please try again.' error

Create app/templates/employee/submit_tas.html extending base.html: Bootstrap card with form title 'Submit Travel Approval Request'; form fields: travel_from text input, travel_to text input, travel_date_start date input (HTML5 type='date'), travel_date_end date input, purpose textarea rows=4, estimated_cost number input min=0 step=0.01; all fields required with Bootstrap validation styling; submit button 'Submit TAS'; CSRF token via {{ form.hidden_tag() }}; validation errors display with Bootstrap alert-danger for each field.errors

Implement GET /employee/dashboard with @employee_required: query employee's recent TAS records (TASRecord.filter_by(emp_id=current_user.emp_id).order_by(submitted_at.desc()).limit(5).all()); calculate summary stats (total_submissions = count all, pending_count = count status='Pending'); render employee/dashboard.html with welcome message using current_user.employee_profile.name, summary stats, recent submissions

Create app/templates/employee/dashboard.html extending base.html: welcome card 'Welcome, {{ current_user.employee_profile.name }}'; quick action buttons card with links 'Submit New TAS' to employee.submit_tas and 'View TAS History' to employee.tas_history; summary stats card showing 'Total Submissions: {total}' and 'Pending Approvals: {pending}' with Bootstrap badges; recent submissions table with 5 rows (TAS Number, Destination, Travel Date, Status with colored badges: Pending=warning yellow, Approved=success green, Rejected=danger red)

Implement GET /employee/tas_history with @employee_required: check current_user.emp_id not None else flash error and redirect to dashboard; query TASRecord.filter_by(emp_id=emp_id).order_by(submitted_at.desc()).all(); render employee/tas_history.html with tas_records list

Create app/templates/employee/tas_history.html extending base.html: title 'My TAS History'; table with class='data-table table table-striped' for DataTables; columns: TAS Number (link to employee.tas_detail), Destination (travel_to), Travel Dates ('{start} to {end}'), Status (colored badge), Submitted Date (format submitted_at); if no records show 'No TAS submissions yet' message with link to submit_tas

Implement GET /employee/tas/<int:tas_id> with @employee_required: query TASRecord by tas_id; if not found abort(404); validate tas_record.emp_id == current_user.emp_id else abort(403 'You do not have permission to view this TAS'); render employee/tas_detail.html with tas_record

Create app/templates/employee/tas_detail.html extending base.html: title 'TAS Details'; info card showing TAS Number, Status badge, Submitted Date; travel details card showing From, To, Travel Dates, Purpose, Estimated Cost; if status=='Approved' or 'Rejected' show approval info card with Reviewed Date, Reviewed By (query user and employee name), if Rejected show Rejection Reason; back link to tas_history

Implement GET /admin/tas_list with @admin_required: parse query params (status optional, date_from optional, date_to optional, department optional); build query TASRecord join Employee; apply filters if provided (status, date range with same +1 day logic as export, department); execute query.all(); render admin/tas_list.html with tas_records and filter values

Create app/templates/admin/tas_list.html extending base.html: title 'All TAS Records'; filter form (status dropdown All/Pending/Approved/Rejected, date_from/date_to date inputs, department text input, submit 'Apply Filters' button, reset link to clear filters); table with class='data-table table table-striped'; columns: TAS Number (link to admin.tas_detail), Employee Name (from join), Department, Destination (travel_to), Travel Start Date, Status (colored badge), Submitted At, Actions (View button, Approve button if Pending, Reject button if Pending); if no records show 'No TAS records found' message

Implement GET /admin/tas/<int:tas_id> with @admin_required: query TASRecord by tas_id with employee join; if not found abort(404); query reviewer user and employee if reviewed_by not None; render admin/tas_detail.html with tas_record, employee, reviewer_info

Create app/templates/admin/tas_detail.html extending base.html: title 'TAS Details - {tas_number}'; employee info card (Name, Email, Department, Designation); TAS info card (TAS Number, Status badge, Submitted Date, From, To, Travel Dates, Purpose, Estimated Cost); if status=='Pending' show two forms side-by-side: (1) Approve form: POST to admin.approve_tas with <input type='hidden' name='csrf_token' value='{{ csrf_token() }}'/>, submit button 'Approve' class='btn btn-success'; (2) Reject form: POST to admin.reject_tas with csrf_token hidden field, textarea name='rejection_reason' rows=3 maxlength=500 placeholder='Reason for rejection (optional)', help text 'Maximum 500 characters', submit button 'Reject' class='btn btn-danger'; if status is Approved or Rejected show approval info card (Reviewed Date, Reviewed By name, if Rejected show Rejection Reason); back link to tas_list
In app/routes/admin.py, import validate_csrf from flask_wtf.csrf and ValidationError from wtforms at top

Implement POST /admin/tas/<int:tas_id>/approve with @admin_required (FINDING #2): manually validate CSRF with try: validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token')) except ValidationError: abort(403); query TASRecord by tas_id; if not found abort(404); if tas_record.status != 'Pending' flash 'TAS has already been processed' warning and redirect to admin.tas_detail; update tas_record.status = 'Approved', tas_record.reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow(), tas_record.reviewed_by = current_user.user_id; try: db.session.commit(), flash 'TAS approved successfully' success, redirect to admin.tas_detail; except Exception as e: db.session.rollback(), current_app.logger.error(f'Error approving TAS: {str(e)}', exc_info=True), flash 'Error updating TAS status' error, redirect to admin.tas_detail

Implement POST /admin/tas/<int:tas_id>/reject with @admin_required: same manual CSRF validation; query TAS; if not found abort(404); validate status == 'Pending'; get rejection_reason = request.form.get('rejection_reason', '').strip()[:500]; update tas_record.status = 'Rejected', tas_record.reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow(), tas_record.reviewed_by = current_user.user_id, tas_record.rejection_reason = rejection_reason; try: db.session.commit(), flash 'TAS rejected' success, redirect to admin.tas_detail; except Exception with rollback, log, flash error

findings: TAS workflow complete from submission to approval. Design review finding #2 (manual CSRF validation on approve/reject) and #4 (race condition handling with IntegrityError retry) resolved in this feature. Transaction boundary ensures TAS number and record committed atomically. Concurrent submissions tested for race condition handling. All database operations have error handling with rollback and logging.
